operations.purpose: Inspect the T480 Windows host identity and installed memory.
Inspect Windows filesystem capacity and free space.
Schedule a controlled T480 Windows restart after explicit operator approval; callers must poll the control path afterward.
Inspect the active Windows power plan's sleep, hibernation, and lid-close policy without changing it.
Set the active Windows power plan to never sleep or hibernate on AC power and ignore lid close on AC power; battery policy is unchanged.
Capture non-secret T480 maintenance readiness: uptime, BIOS, battery, BitLocker state, Windows Update restart state and active hours, AC power policy, WSL, private lab health, and backup freshness.
Grant the connected T480 Windows account Modify access only to the existing fixed Forex M1/M3 probe directory, so the historical-depth probe can run; requires explicit approval.
Write, read, and remove a fixed temporary file only inside the existing Forex M1/M3 probe directory to diagnose its effective Windows access; requires explicit approval.
Inspect the current Windows WSL distribution visibility and existing lab startup task before creating a boot-triggered Local System task.
Create, run, read, and remove a temporary Local System task that reports whether that Windows account can see the Ubuntu WSL distribution; requires explicit approval.
Create, run, read, and remove a temporary passwordless S4U task that reports whether the registered Windows user can start Ubuntu WSL without interactive logon; requires explicit approval.

Replace the interim sign-in task with a boot-triggered passwordless S4U task that starts the fixed private Ubuntu WSL PostgreSQL/n8n/status-dashboard action and preserves the prior task XML for rollback; requires explicit approval.
Inspect the final M5 boot-triggered S4U task's principal, logon type, trigger, state, and latest result.
Inspect WSL status and installed distributions.
Inspect Docker and Docker Compose availability in Ubuntu.
Inspect potentially conflicting Docker and container-runtime packages in Ubuntu.
Inspect Docker package-source and package-manager evidence after an installation failure.
Confirm that Ubuntu can reach Docker's signed repository before installation.
Prove the adapter can send an exact script to Ubuntu standard input without nested-shell quoting.
Inspect the Windows sign-in task that starts the private T480 n8n lab stack.
Create or update a Windows sign-in task that starts Ubuntu WSL, waits for Docker, starts PostgreSQL plus n8n and the status-only dashboard, and keeps WSL alive.
Run the private lab startup task immediately and verify the local n8n health endpoint.
Inspect the private Windows startup task result and its non-secret local WSL startup log.
Remove the Windows sign-in task that starts the private T480 n8n lab stack.
Verify the active Docker service, installed package, Engine, Compose, and daemon access in a fresh Ubuntu session.
Run Docker's hello-world image as the required real-container proof for M1.
Inspect the private Ollama container and its locally installed embedding models.
Start the private Ollama service and install the approved bge-m3 and mxbai-embed-large embedding models into its persistent model volume.
Inspect the non-secret completion or failure detail from the approved Ollama embedding-model installation.
Inspect T480 Ubuntu capacity, Docker, the intended deployment path, and existing lab containers before M2 deployment.
Clone the approved repository, generate T480-local secrets, validate Compose without printing secrets, pull pinned images, and start PostgreSQL and n8n.
Inspect the local M2 repository, non-secret environment permissions, Compose validity, image state, and containers after a deployment failure.
Start the existing private PostgreSQL and n8n Compose services plus the status-only dashboard, then wait for their health checks.

Verify the private lab's Docker daemon, required container health, PostgreSQL query and pgvector extension, n8n health endpoint, optional running Ollama service, and available capacity without changing the T480.
Inspect private lab container status, memory availability, and recent n8n, PostgreSQL, and Ollama logs after a runtime failure.
Capture non-secret installed n8n image and version, reviewed target image, private binding, health, and capacity before an approved n8n upgrade.
Create and integrity-check a fresh host-side PostgreSQL backup before an approved n8n upgrade.
Pull and deploy only the reviewed digest-pinned n8n 1.123.65 image, then report version and private service health.
Verify the newest T480 M2 evidence bundle and return its manifest fingerprint.
Fast-forward the existing T480 lab checkout to the approved origin/main revision, refusing a non-clean worktree.
Read the fixed T480 lab checkout status and local versus fetched origin/main revisions without changing it.
Read only the local diff for the three T480 adapter contract files before a controlled checkout update.
Back up only zero-byte Git objects in the fixed T480 lab checkout, fetch origin/main, and fast-forward only if the repaired checkout is clean.
Restore only the three known zero-byte T480 adapter contract files from fetched origin/main, then fast-forward only if clean.
Finalize only the verified three-file corrupt-contract restore by aligning Git index and HEAD with fetched origin/main without changing working files.
Deploy only the reviewed hash-pinned Forex revision to the fixed private T480 checkout, refusing a dirty or differently-originated checkout.
Hash-check and stage only the reviewed retained M1 capture from fixed private Windows staging into the fixed Forex checkout.
Create and restore a timestamped synthetic PostgreSQL database backup, producing an M3 evidence bundle without touching the n8n database.
Verify the newest T480 M3 recovery evidence bundle and return its manifest fingerprint.
Inspect the fixed private MP4 transcription checkout, its local configuration, built image, and whether its temporary inbox is empty.
Inspect fixed transcriber container state, the private inbox, and the latest non-secret job metadata after a transcription interruption or failure.
Return the SHA-256 values of successfully completed private transcription jobs so a folder submission can resume without duplicate work.
Remove only temporary T480 inbox copies whose SHA-256 exactly matches a successfully completed review-required job; requires explicit approval.
Copy only completed review-required transcription job folders to the fixed private T480 Windows export directory for governed retrieval; requires explicit approval.
Clone or fast-forward the fixed MP4 transcription repository, create local-only configuration and transient directories, and build its CPU-only image; requires explicit approval.
Build the fixed private MP4 transcription image and create its private transient inbox and output directories; requires explicit approval.
Create and verify the fixed private Windows OpenSSH staging directory is empty before a governed MP4 transfer; requires explicit approval.
Explicitly download only the approved faster-whisper base model into the private persistent T480 cache, without handling any media; requires explicit approval.

Run exactly one lexically first MP4 from the fixed private transcription inbox through the fixed one-shot CPU worker, then remove only that successful temporary inbox copy; requires explicit approval.

Recover exactly one retained private inbox MP4 after an interrupted folder submission by running the fixed one-shot CPU worker and deleting that temporary copy only after success; requires explicit approval.
Cancel and mark failed only the newer of exactly two concurrently running transcription containers created by an interrupted recovery; requires explicit approval.
Install Docker Engine and the Compose plugin in Ubuntu, then grant the fixed Ubuntu user Docker access.
